chartChangeType.label: Change Chart Type
chartChangeType.description: Draw every series as another type of chart.

chartSwitchRowColumn.label: Switch Row/Column
chartSwitchRowColumn.description: Plot the data's rows as series instead of its columns, or the other way round.

chartSelectData.label: Select Data
chartSelectData.description: Change the cells the chart plots.

chartAddElement.label: Add Chart Element
chartAddElement.description: Add, move or remove a title, legend, data labels, data table, gridlines, axis titles, trendlines, error bars, lines or up/down bars.

chartTitleToggle.label: Chart Title
chartTitleToggle.description: Show the chart's title above the chart, or remove it.

chartLegendToggle.label: Legend
chartLegendToggle.description: Show the legend at the right, or remove it.

chartDataLabelsToggle.label: Data Labels
chartDataLabelsToggle.description: Label every point with its value, or remove the labels.

chartDataTableToggle.label: Data Table
chartDataTableToggle.description: Show the plotted values in a table under the chart, or remove it.

chartGridlinesToggle.label: Gridlines
chartGridlinesToggle.description: Show the value axis's major gridlines, or remove them.

chartAxisTitlesToggle.label: Axis Titles
chartAxisTitlesToggle.description: Show a title on each primary axis, or remove them.
